dataset.reference_labeling: CISA SSVC Decision Rubric (Act=3, Attend=2, Track=1, Defer=0; author-curated heuristic judgments)

metrics.ndcg_at_k: Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain evaluated at K=5, K=10, K=15 using standard formula sum((2^rel - 1) / log2(i+2)) normalized by IDCG@K.
metrics.precision_at_k: Fraction of top K ranked items meeting relevance threshold (threshold=3 for Act/Emergency; threshold=2 for Actionable).
metrics.recall_at_k: Fraction of total relevant items retrieved in top K.
metrics.spearman: Spearman Rank Correlation Coefficient between predicted ranking and reference priority order (mid-rank tie-corrected).
